## BContinuousParameter  
  
The [`BContinuousParameter`](BContinuousParameter.md "BContinuousParameter") class represents parameters whose values can vary along a continuous range. Examples include gain or equalizer controls, turntable pitch controls, and the like.

The default system theme implements [`BContinuousParameter`](BContinuousParameter.md "BContinuousParameter")s as [`BSlider`](BSlider.md "BSlider") controls.

Call [`BParameterGroup::MakeContinuousParameter()`](BParameterGroup.md#BParameterGroup_MakeContinuousParameter "MakeContinuousParameter\(\)") to create a [`BContinuousParameter`](BContinuousParameter.md "BContinuousParameter") control.
